dict.string: Unsigned SideStore preview, version 0.1.6 build 22: adds manual reviewed association of one exact retained file with one explicitly selected imported visible message. Choose both yourself, then confirm; no filename matching or automatic media restoration is claimed. Supported files are validated locally up to 10 MiB, with immutable receipts, replay protection and original-byte verification. Old restore receipts that preserved existing conversations cannot prove target membership and are not eligible. Original ZIPs, local edits and unlinked reference records remain preserved. The speculative legacy assetsJson parser is not included. Retains prior import memory safeguards and read-only inventory. Physical-device and full private-archive acceptance remain unverified. No video downloading, broader autonomy, vision or sync is added. Preserve app data and signing identity when updating.
Orivyn uses the microphone only when you start dictation or a voice conversation.
Orivyn transcribes your speech on this iPhone when you start dictation or voice conversation.
Only when you tap Get current location, Orivyn asks iOS for a one-time location displayed on this screen. It is not sent to a model or server.
Only when you connect to your chosen plugin server, Orivyn may access that server on your local network. Chats and files are not sent automatically.
Take a photo to attach and recognize its text on this iPhone.
